roles.name: signin
roles._why: Pre-login surface, captured on purpose: the design has three auth frames (Sign In, Sign In / Officer Tab, Choose Portal) that no authenticated crawl can ever reach. Its captures are exempt from the login-page gate for that reason and no other.

live._environment_why: Explicit. An undeclared environment fails SAFE to 'prod', which refuses every destructive click and would silently starve the flow captures of their later steps.
live._navMode_why: Measured, not assumed, on 2026-09-11: logging in as admin and then hard-reloading /best-practices keeps the session. NMBA does not have SMILE-Beggary's refresh-logout defect, so the default goto crawl is safe and the SPA click-crawl is not needed.
live._skipRoutes_why: /login stays skipped for the AUTHENTICATED roles, which would only redirect away from it. The `signin` role still captures it, because the crawl always captures its own landing route.

notes: Passwords live in secrets.json (gitignored). Credentials re-verified 2026-09-11 against the shared 'Portal access - DEV and UAT test Logins' sheet - the three stored passwords still match. That sheet also lists five further NMBA roles with working credentials (CPLI, ODIC, DDAC, USDP, Line Ministry), each with its own design section on the handoff page; whether they are in scope is a decision recorded in the report, not an omission.
_claimGates_why: Fatal for this project. The July 2026 pass predates the gates entirely, so every claim carried forward has to survive them before it can ship again.
